title: 角色创建与性别选项引发争议
description: 角色创建过程中强制玩家选择代词、默认性取向或进入同性关系，缺乏选择自由，部分玩家对此感到不适或反感。
evidence: this game uses pronouns which shold not exist in games
I'd like to have my character assume other's gender based on observable characteristics, as it stands  everybody is nonbinary I guess?

there is a high focus on character portraits, but they are complete detached from the pronounces.
it ruins the immersion when characters have randomly assigned beards and hairstyles, randomly assigned male or female names, and are randomly described as female, male, or gender-neutral.

evidence_items.quote: I was't even sure which of 2 provided portraits of my char parents was mother and who was father
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时父母性别不明确
evidence_items.quote_zh: 太政治正确了，以至于我甚至不确定提供的那两张我角色父母的画像里哪个是母亲、哪个是父亲。代词之类的那套玩意儿也在。甚至在我开始游玩之前就让我极其反感。我当初第一次买这个的时候应该好好查一查的。

evidence_items.quote: this game uses pronouns which shold not exist in games
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏使用了代词，而代词本不该存在于游戏中

evidence_items.quote: I had to choose a pronoun for my character
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时强制选择代词
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不得不为我的角色选择一个人称代词

evidence_items.quote: your character is automatically made gay by default if you just create a new character without checking
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时默认自动成为同性恋，且角色会在玩家不玩时与其他NPC发生性关系
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你只是创建一个新角色而不去检查，你的角色默认就会自动被设定为同性恋

evidence_items.quote: all the women are scarred, old, deformed and gay
evidence_items.description: 女性角色被设计成有伤疤、年老、畸形或同性恋
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所有女人都满脸伤疤、又老、畸形，而且是同性恋

evidence_items.quote: The game now has "He/Him, She/Her, They/Them" crap forced onto player characters.
evidence_items.description: 游戏强制玩家角色使用性别代词选项
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏现在把“He/Him、She/Her、They/Them”这种垃圾强行加到玩家角色身上。

evidence_items.quote: They did the whole gender-nonsense, as if everyone gets to space and goes trans.
evidence_items.description: 游戏包含性别意识形态内容，仿佛所有人上太空后都会变性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们搞了整套性别胡闹的东西，好像每个人到了太空都会变性似的。

evidence_items.quote:
there is a high focus on character portraits, but they are complete detached from the pronounces.
it ruins the immersion when characters have randomly assigned beards and hairstyles, randomly assigned male or female names, and are randomly described as female, male, or gender-neutral.
evidence_items.description: 角色头像与代词不一致，随机分配性别特征
evidence_items.quote_zh:
游戏非常注重角色肖像，但这些肖像与代词完全脱节。
当角色被随机分配胡须和发型、随机分配男性或女性名字，并被随机描述为女性、男性或性别中立时，这破坏了沉浸感。

evidence_items.description: 游戏包含觉醒代词内容

evidence_items.quote: the authors had just added a choice between the two existing genders
evidence_items.description: 主角为无性别跨性别类人角色，且没有性别选择
evidence_items.quote_zh: 作者们本来只是加入了在现有的两种性别之间进行选择的功能

evidence_items.description: 角色创建提供They/Them代词选项

evidence_items.quote: I'd like to have my character assume other's gender based on observable characteristics, as it stands  everybody is nonbinary I guess?
evidence_items.description: 希望角色能根据可观察特征判断他人性别，目前所有人都是非二元
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我希望我的角色能根据可观察的特征来推断他人的性别，就目前而言，所有人都是非二元性别吧？

evidence_items.quote: there are the delusional gender ideology on it
evidence_items.description: 游戏包含性别意识形态内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 里面有那种妄想的性别意识形态

evidence_items.quote: Choosing a character background and discovering that the flirt part in your previous choice was a gay move that led you to be in a gay relationship for a whole year may not be everyone's cup of tea... Not that having a gay character is a problem, the problem is being forced a gay character
evidence_items.description: 选择角色背景时，玩家被迫进入同性关系，无法避免。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 选择一个角色背景，然后发现你之前选择中的调情部分是一个同性恋举动，导致你陷入了一段整整一年的同性恋关系，这可能不是每个人的菜……并不是说有一个同性恋角色是个问题，问题是被强迫成为一个同性恋角色

evidence_items.quote: one of the events has me seduce someone I don't know the name of, find out afterwards it's a dude, so I guess my character is gay now
evidence_items.description: 角色创建时被迫进入同性关系。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 其中一个事件让我去勾引一个我连名字都不知道的人，事后才发现那是个男的，所以我猜我的角色现在是同性恋了
